messages:
rachel: FYI: we're rolling out GitHub Merge Queue (MQ) org-wide next week to improve CI throughput and reduce flakey merge-time failures. Cutover: 2026-05-18 20:00-21:00 UTC.

rachel: TL;DR: new protected-branch flow uses MQ checks instead of direct merges. You will need to enable the app for repos you own and remove direct write perms from most bots. No data loss, but PR merges will be gated.

tom: ack. What breaks immediately?

rachel: Jobs that expect direct pushes to main (eg. post-merge scripts triggered by push events) may need to listen for MQ merge events or the resulting merge commit. CI that relies on `GITHUB_EVENT_NAME == push` right after merge should handle `workflow_run` or `repository_dispatch` instead.

ben: how do I opt my repo in?

rachel: Repo owners: enable Merge Queue in org settings > Apps and add the MQ bot as a required status check in branch protection. We published `platform/scripts/mq/enable-mq-for-repo.sh` that does it for you.

security: Also remove any secrets that allow automation to bypass branch protection (e.g., legacy deploy bots pushing). We'll rotate those creds. If you need an exception, open PLAT-11002.

ci-bot: Example scan to find workflows relying on push-after-merge patterns:
```bash
rg "on:\s*push" .github/workflows -n || true
rg "repository_dispatch|workflow_run" .github/workflows -n || true
```

rachel: Example minimal MQ workflow change: replace direct merge step with `uses: redwood/mq-merge@v1` (auth via app token). See `platform/docs/merge-queue.md`.

ben: Rollback/mitigation?

rachel: Rollback is turning MQ off for the repo and reverting branch-protection to allow org maintainers merge. We'll only rollback if >5% of merges fail or if automation can't be updated within the window. We'll keep a 2-hour monitoring window post-cutover.

platform-eng: We'll run a dry-run in staging 2026-05-18 18:30 UTC. Owners, please run the enable script beforehand for faster testing.

ci-bot: Dry-run started in staging at 18:30:10 UTC. No blocker detected.

rachel: Live rollout started 20:00:05 UTC. Applying protection updates and enabling MQ for opted repos.

ci-bot: Live rollout completed 20:22:41 UTC. MQ enabled for 83 repos; 12 repos flagged for manual opt-in.

security: Monitoring shows no unauthorized bypasses. A few automation scripts needed minor edits to respond to `merge_queue` events.

ben: migrated my repo, updated CI listeners. all green.

rachel: Thanks everyone. If your repo was flagged for manual opt-in, please add a note in PLAT-11002. We'll keep branch protections in read-only for 48h for safety. Closing thread.
